"""Delivery helpers.

This module sends a payload through a caller-provided transport. Transient
failures are those the transport may recover from on a later attempt.
"""

DEFAULT_DELAY = 1
MAX_ATTEMPTS = 1


def deliver(send, payload):
    """Send the payload once.

    Callers currently observe every error; retry semantics are documented
    in the acceptance criteria and will follow.
    """
    return send(payload)
